overview: The **User Account** drop-in emits account data changes and errors, enabling real-time updates when customer information, addresses, or preferences are modified.

user-account/data.description: Emitted when customer account data is loaded or updated. This includes personal information, addresses, and account settings.

customer.description: The complete customer data structure including email, name, addresses, and account preferences.

user-account/error.description: Emitted when an error occurs during account operations such as updating profile information, managing addresses, or changing passwords.

error.description: Error details including message, code, and context about which account operation failed.

user-account/initialized.description: Emitted when the user account component completes initialization. This indicates the account data is loaded and the component is ready for user interaction.
